address: 7-17 Gejia Cove, Shushan Village, Dashishan Road, Huqiu, Suzhou, China Mainland
bio: Off the beaten track in Shushan Ecological Village, this restaurant is set in an idyllic landscape. Despite its distance from the city centre, locals flock here for authentic Suzhou cooking while on a day out in Suzhou's majestic nature. The signature braised goose is repeatedly steeped in an aged marinade with 16 spices so that the flavour penetrates deep into the bones. Clams with baby burr clovers are a classic with a unique grassy fragrance....
